description: Java entity class representing product option values in an e-commerce system, including fields for image, code, descriptions, and display options.

classes.name: ProductOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class for product option values, including properties for sorting, image, code, descriptions, and merchant store association.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Returns the image filename or path for the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image filename or path for the product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for the product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for the product option value.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, initializing from the set if necessary.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the MultipartFile image for upload.

methods.name: isProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Checks if the product option is display-only.

methods.name: setProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option is display-only.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the product option value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the product option value.
